SELECT 'live_legs_on_BMUBOG' k, count(*)::text v FROM (SELECT DISTINCT market_ticker FROM live_orders WHERE strategy='Fmmsell10' AND action='buy' AND status IN ('pending','unknown','submitted','resting','partial','filled') AND market_ticker LIKE '%26SEP10BMUBOG%') z
UNION ALL SELECT 'live_ANY_order_on_BMUBOG', count(*)::text FROM live_orders WHERE strategy='Fmmsell10' AND market_ticker LIKE '%26SEP10BMUBOG%'
UNION ALL SELECT 'paper_rows_on_BMUBOG_live_tag', count(*)::text FROM paper_trades WHERE strategy='Fmmsell10' AND market_ticker LIKE '%26SEP10BMUBOG%'
UNION ALL SELECT 'uncapped_legs_on_BMUBOG', count(DISTINCT market_ticker)::text FROM paper_trades WHERE strategy='mmsell10' AND market_ticker LIKE '%26SEP10BMUBOG%'
UNION ALL SELECT 'skipped_contest_cap_2h', COALESCE(sum((raw_json->>'skipped_contest_cap')::int),0)::text FROM system_events WHERE component='mmsell_scan' AND created_at > now()-interval '2 hours'
ORDER BY 1
